name: setup-msbuild
description: Helps set up MSBuild into PATH for later usage.

vswhere-path.description: Folder location of where vswhere.exe is located if a self-hosted agent

vs-version.description: Version of Visual Studio to search; defaults to latest if not specified

vs-prerelease.description: Enable searching for pre-release versions of Visual Studio/MSBuild

msbuild-architecture.description: The preferred processor architecture of MSBuild. Can be either "x86", "x64", or "arm64". "x64" is only available from Visual Studio version 17.0 and later.
